channelTitle: Grandma June never chews gum before a visit, she does this instead
hook: No gum, no mints from a tin, just a little pot on the windowsill Grandma June snips from before anyone comes over.
remedy: Chewing a fresh mint leaf or two straight from the plant is an old, simple home remedy for quick, natural-tasting fresh breath, no packaging or added sugar needed.
steps: Pick a couple of fresh, clean mint leaves
Chew slowly for a minute or two, then discard
caution: Make sure the mint hasn't been treated with pesticides if it's from outside your own garden.
cta: Do you keep a mint plant at home for exactly this? Tell Grandma June in the comments.
